name: Hophni
meaning: A corrupt priest, son of Eli.
notes: Hophni, along with his brother Phinehas, was a corrupt priest who served under his father Eli at the tabernacle in Shiloh.

name: Hophra
meaning: Pharaoh during Jeremiah's time.
notes: Hophra, also known as Pharaoh Apries, was the king of Egypt during the time of the prophet Jeremiah and the Babylonian invasion of Judah.

name: Horam
meaning: King of Gezer, defeated by Joshua.
notes: Horam, the king of Gezer, came to help Lachish but was defeated by Joshua and the Israelites.

name: Hori
meaning: A Horite people group.
notes: The Horites were a people group who inhabited the region of Seir before the Edomites.

name: Hori

notes: Hori, the son of Shaphat, was one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore the land of Canaan.

name: Horonites

name: Hosah

name: Hosea
meaning: A prophet to the northern kingdom of Israel.
notes: Hosea was a prophet who ministered to the northern kingdom of Israel during the reigns of several kings, calling the people to repent and return to God.

name: Hoshaiah
meaning: A military leader during Jeremiah's time.
notes: Hoshaiah, the son of Maaseiah, was one of the military leaders who sought Jeremiah's counsel after the fall of Jerusalem but later disobeyed his prophetic warning.

name: Hoshaiah
meaning: A leader during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
notes: Hoshaiah was one of the leaders who participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Hoshama
meaning: A descendant of King Jeconiah of Judah.
notes: Hoshama was a descendant of Jeconiah, the exiled king of Judah, according to the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

name: Hoshea
meaning: Leader of the half-tribe of Ephraim.
notes: Hoshea, the son of Azaziah, was the leader of the half-tribe of Ephraim during King David's reign.

name: Hoshea
meaning: The last king of Israel (northern kingdom).
notes: Hoshea was the last king of Israel, reigning from around 732 to 722 BC, until the Assyrian conquest of Samaria.

name: Hoshea
meaning: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
notes: Hoshea was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

name: Hotham
meaning: One of David's mighty warriors from Aroer.
notes: Hotham the Aroerite was listed among David's mighty warriors known for their military exploits.

name: Hotham
meaning: A descendant of Asher.
notes: Hotham, also known as Helem, was a descendant of Asher mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Hothir
meaning: A son of Heman, a musician in David's court.
notes: Hothir was one of the fourteen sons of Heman, appointed by King David to lead worship in the temple.

name: huge_man
meaning: A huge man from Gath, killed by David's warriors.
notes: A huge man from Gath, possibly a descendant of the Rephaim, was killed by David's warriors during a battle with the Philistines.

name: Hul
meaning: A son of Aram, grandson of Shem.
notes: Hul was one of the sons of Aram and a grandson of Shem, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Huldah
meaning: A prophetess during the reign of King Josiah.

name: Huppah
meaning: A priest during David's reign.

name: Huppim
meaning: A descendant of Manasseh.
notes: Huppim is mentioned in the genealogy of Manasseh as a descendant of Ir or as a son of Machir.

name: Huppim
meaning: A descendant of Benjamin.
notes: Huppim, also known as Hupham or Huram, was a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

name: Hur
meaning: One of Solomon's twelve district governors.
notes: Hur was one of the twelve district governors appointed by King Solomon to oversee the provision of food for the royal household.

name: Hur
meaning: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.
notes: Hur was a prominent figure during the Israelites' journey in the wilderness, serving as a support to Moses and the grandfather of Bezalel, the chief artisan of the tabernacle.

name: Hur
meaning: A ruler who helped repair Jerusalem's wall.
notes: Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, was involved in repairing a section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

name: Hur
meaning: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites.

name: Huri
meaning: A descendant of Gad.
notes: Huri was a descendant of Gad, mentioned in the genealogy of the Gadites.

name: Hushah
meaning: A son or town founded by Ezer.
notes: Hushah was either a descendant of Judah or a town founded by Ezer in the tribe of.

name: Hushai

name: Husham
meaning: A king of Edom.
notes: Husham was a king of Edom who reigned before the Israelites had kings, according to the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Hushathites
meaning: A clan or family known for their warriors.
notes: The Hushathites were a clan or family that produced several of David's mighty warriors, including Sibbecai and Mebunnai.

name: Hushim
meaning: A son of Aher, from the tribe of Dan.
notes: Hushim, a son of Aher, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Dan in 1 Chronicles.

name: Hushim
meaning: A son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite.
notes: Hushim was one of the sons of Shaharaim, a Benjamite, born to him in the country of Moab.

name: Hushim
meaning: Son of Dan, ancestor of the Shuhamites.
notes: Hushim, also known as Shuham, was the son of Dan and the ancestor of the Shuhamite clan within the tribe of Dan.

name: Hymenaeus
meaning: A man who rejected faith and good conscience.
notes: Hymenaeus was a man who had rejected the faith and was handed over to Satan by Paul so that he might learn not to blaspheme.

name: Ibhar
meaning: One of King David's sons born in Jerusalem.

name: Ibneiah
meaning: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.

name: Ibnijah
meaning: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.
notes: Ibnijah, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the Israelites who resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Ibri

name: Ibsam
meaning: A descendant of Issachar.
notes: Ibsam was a descendant of Issachar, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Issachar in 1 Chronicles.

name: Ibzan
meaning: A judge of Israel from Bethlehem.

name: Ichabod
meaning: Son of Phinehas, born when the ark was captured.
notes: Ichabod was the son of Phinehas, born when the ark of God was captured by the Philistines and named to reflect the departure of glory from Israel.

name: Idbash
meaning: A descendant of Judah.

name: Iddo
meaning: Zechariah's son, a leader of Manasseh

name: Iddo
meaning: A Levite in the genealogy of temple singers

name: Iddo
meaning: Abinadab's son, an official under King Solomon

name: Iddo
meaning: A seer and prophet during the divided monarchy

name: Iddo
meaning: Zechariah's grandfather, a priest and prophet in post-exilic Judah
notes: Iddo, the grandfather of the prophet Zechariah, was a priest and prophet in post-exilic Judah.

name: Iddo

name: Iddo

name: Igal
meaning: A descendant of David.

name: Igal
meaning: One of David's mighty warriors.

name: Igal
meaning: A scout from the tribe of Issachar.

name: Igdaliah
meaning: A man of God during Jeremiah's time.
notes: Igdaliah, a man of God, was associated with a chamber in the house of the Lord during the time of the prophet Jeremiah.

name: Ikkesh

name: Imlah
meaning: Father of the prophet Micaiah.

name: Immer

name: Immer

name: Immer

name: Imna

name: Imnah

name: Imnah

name: Imrah
meaning: A descendant of Asher.
notes: Imrah was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

name: Imri

name: Iphdeiah

name: Ir

name: Ira

name: Ira

name: Ira

name: Iru

name: Isaac

name: Isaiah

name: Iscah
meaning: Daughter of Haran, Milcah's sister, Lot's sister.
notes: Iscah was the daughter of Haran and sister of Milcah and Lot.

name: Ishbah
meaning: Son of Mered in the genealogy of Judah

name: Ishbak
meaning: Son of Abraham and Keturah.

name: Ishbi-benob

name: Ish-bosheth

name: Ishhod

name: Ishi

name: Ishi

name: Ishi

name: Ishi

name: Ishmael

name: Ishmael
meaning: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.

name: Ishmael

name: Ishmael
meaning: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

name: Ishmaiah
meaning: Gibeonite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

name: Ishmaiah

name: Ishmerai

name: Ishpah

notes: Ishpah was a descendant of Benjamin through Beriah.

name: Ishpan

notes: Ishpan was a descendant of Benjamin through Shashak.

name: Ishvah
meaning: Son of Asher, grandson of Jacob.

name: Ishvi

name: Ismachiah

name: Israel

name: Issachar

name: Issachar
meaning: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

name: Isshiah

name: Isshiah

name: Isshiah

name: Isshiah

name: Isshijah

name: Ithamar

name: Ithiel

name: Ithiel
meaning: Mentioned in Agur's sayings; meaning uncertain.

name: Ithmah

name: Ithran
meaning: Descendant of Asher, son of Zophah.

name: Ithran

name: Ithream

name: Ittai

name: Ittai

name: Izhar

name: Izhar

name: Izliah

name: Izrahiah

name: Jaazaniah

name: Jaaziah

name: Jaaziel

name: Jabal

name: Jabez

name: Jabin

name: Jabin

name: Jacan

name: Jachin

name: Jahaziel
